Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the powers of homeowners' associations.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to homeowners' associations; and adding a newsection to chapter 64.38 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 64.38 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The governing documents may not prohibit the outdoor display ofpolitical yard signs by an owner or resident on the owner's orresident's property for a period of ninety days before any primary orelection. The governing documents may include reasonable rules andregulations regarding the placement and manner of display of politicalyard signs. (2) For purposes of this section, "political yard sign" means anyoutdoor sign with dimensions no greater than eight feet by four feetthat contains a message supporting or opposing a candidate or ballotmeasure that will be on a primary or election ballot within ninetydays. (3) This section applies retroactively to any governing documentsin effect on the effective date of this section. Any provision in a p. 1 SB 6064governing document in effect on the effective date of this section thatis inconsistent with this section is void and unenforceable.
